careers.homedepot.com is a WordPress site using Symphony Talent CWS plugin backed by the m-cloud jobs API. GET returns JSON {totalHits, queryResult:[{id,title,description(HTML),url,primary_city,...}]}; description is inline so no detail call is needed. fuzzy=false narrows to 40 hits (19481 without). offset is 1-based. ATS behind it is Workday (homedepot.wd5/CareerDepot is login-only).

Public URL jobs.kroger.com redirects to www.krogerfamilycareers.com/en/sites/CX_2001 (a vanity proxy); hcmRestApi calls on that host 302 to the real pod eluq.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com, so use eluq host directly. Response is gzip: use curl --compressed. TotalJobsCount=9984 (keyword search is loose).

Phenom site (mycareer.verizon.com) fully behind Cloudflare JS challenge: POST /widgets, search HTML and job pages all return 403 for curl regardless of UA/HTTP version. Only https://mycareer.verizon.com/en/jobs/sitemap.xml is fetchable (lists job URLs like /jobs/r-1100824/senior-technical-product-manager-ai-network-infrastructure/ but the pages themselves are 403). No public Workday tenant found (verizon.wd1/wd3/wd5 do not exist).
